title: VaultBrokerServerAdapter
responsibility: Serves the Credential Vault broker as JSON over an owner-only Unix socket.

inputs.name: VaultBrokerServerAdapter.constructor.config
inputs.description: Broker, lease keeper, device repository, socket path and an optional kernel peer-uid lookup.

outputs.name: VaultBrokerServerAdapter.listen
outputs.description: The socket path, once listening with mode 0600 in a 0700 directory.

outputs.name: VaultBrokerServerAdapter.close
outputs.description: Resolves after the server closes and the socket file is removed.

errors.name: VaultBrokerError
errors.description: Returned as a JSON {error} response, not thrown: 404 'Unknown route.' for an unknown path or non-POST, 415 'Expected an application/json request.', 413 'Request is too large.' over 400 KiB, 400 for a body the wire schema refuses, and any broker, keeper or device refusal with its own status. Any other failure is answered 500 'Broker error.' without detail.

errors.name: NodeJS.ErrnoException
errors.description: Rejects with the file-system or listen error when the directory or socket cannot be created.

outputs.name: VaultBrokerServerAdapter.listen
outputs.description: The socket path, once listening with mode 0600 in a 0700 directory.
